guidelines.title: Guidelines for Eco-Friendly Visarjan
guidelines.subtitle: Protecting Bhopal's sacred water bodies following NGT orders and CPCB norms.
guidelines.do_1: Immerse idols only in designated artificial kunds built by BMC.
guidelines.do_2: Remove all flowers, clothes, plastic garlands and decorations before immersion.
guidelines.do_3: Deposit organic puja materials in marked 'Nirmalya Kalash' bins.
guidelines.do_4: Opt for natural clay (mitti/shhadu) idols with biodegradable plant dyes.
guidelines.dont_1: No immersion of idols into the open waters of Upper Lake (Bada Talab) or Lower Lake.
guidelines.dont_2: Do not throw plastic bags, thermocol structures, or toxic chemicals into water.
guidelines.dont_3: Do not bypass barricades or enter deep water zones without municipal lifeguards.
guidelines.dont_4: Do not dump post-immersion debris onto the banks or road verges.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
faq.subtitle: Get clear answers regarding immersion rules, ghat amenities, and water testing.
faq.q1: Where can large public pandal idols be immersed this year?
faq.a1: Large idols must be taken to the dedicated civic immersion kunds at Bairagarh (Sant Hirdaram Kund), Prempura artificial tanks, and Khatlapura designated enclosure. Direct immersion in the main lake is prohibited by the NGT.
faq.q2: What is Dissolved Oxygen (DO) and why does it matter?
faq.a2: Dissolved Oxygen is the amount of oxygen available in the water for fish and aquatic life. CPCB Class B requires at least 5.0 mg/L. When organic matter and paints decay, oxygen drops, harming lake health.
faq.q3: Are there lifeguards and cranes stationed at the ghats?
faq.a3: Yes. Bhopal Municipal Corporation deploys heavy duty hydraulic cranes, SDRF rescue teams, and trained divers at all 7 designated immersion ghats throughout the festival.
faq.q4: How do I collect the Nirmalya (puja flowers and leaves)?
faq.a4: BMC provides dedicated yellow 'Nirmalya Vahan' vehicles and designated collection bins at all ghat entrances. This material is collected separately for sacred eco-composting.
faq.q5: Is there a fee for registering a visarjan slot?
faq.a5: No. The Visarjan slot registration is completely free of charge. It helps the municipal control room stagger arrival crowds and prevent traffic jams.
